metadata.description: Claude marketplace for agent-runtime-kit — 9 plugins (code-review, computer-use, conversation, dispatch, issue, media, meta, pr, reporting). Resolves to ~/.claude/plugins/<plugin>/ when installed by `agent-runtime install --product claude`.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Read-only multi-lens code review — code-review-specialists with api-contract / data-migration / maintainability / performance / red-team / security / testing lenses.

plugins.name: computer-use
plugins.description: macOS desktop automation and GUI testing through nils-cli macos-agent, locally or over SSH.

plugins.name: conversation
plugins.description: Conversation-to-artifact workflows — discussion-to-implementation-doc, guided-feature-build, and handoff-session-prompt.

plugins.name: dispatch
plugins.description: Two governed plan outcomes — L2 plan tracking and L3 multi-lane dispatch — with lifecycle phases routed internally.

plugins.name: issue
plugins.description: GitHub and GitLab issue outcomes — issue-follow-up and issue-triage.

plugins.name: media
plugins.description: Screen and image capture — screen-record, image-processing wrappers backed by nils-cli media tools.

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Explicit runtime and repository maintenance outcomes — bootstrap, deploy, skill lifecycle, release, setup, sync, version bump, and worktree triage.

plugins.name: pr
plugins.description: One governed GitHub/GitLab PR and MR delivery outcome with create, review, repair, merge, close, and abandon modes routed internally.

plugins.name: reporting
plugins.description: Read-only synthesis skills — daily-brief, topic-radar, project-retro.
